name: quantcalc
description: Run real Monte Carlo retirement projections, get the tax-aware withdrawal order and Roth-conversion programme the engine selects, compare published capital market assumptions, and compute 2026 tax figures — a federal and state return estimate, income tax and take-home pay, RMDs, Roth conversion cost, QCDs, IRMAA tiers, taxable Social Security, capital gains, estimated payments, the ACA credit and state tax in every state — on the QuantCalc engines, not estimated by the model. The projections, IRMAA tiers, RMDs and the 2027 ACA cliff are free; the tax figures need a licence key.

license_key.title: QuantCalc PRO licence key
license_key.description: Optional. Without one, projections run at 2,000 paths and the tax-aware tool returns the first retirement year of its schedule. A PRO key raises runs to 10,000 paths and returns the full schedule, and a PRO or Tax Season Pass key enables the 2026 tax tools (the return estimate, the every-state ranking and the tax calculators); it is held at the connection, never passed through the conversation.
